precision: FP32 native; matmul and convolution TF32 off; benchmark off; deterministic algorithms off; no MCDNN determinism controls, v1/v2/portable, or CPU model fallback
selection: Final epoch only, no best-epoch/seed selection, no automatic retry
verdict: Report all signed/absolute percentage-point differences; no equivalence/pass claim
scope: Complete declared CIFAR-10/PennFudan budgets, not full ImageNet/COCO convergence

yolov5s.provenance: Native UP YOLOv5-S SiLU; one foreground class, EMA off

vit_b16.provenance: Native UP ViT-B16; 12 blocks, width768, 17 tokens, 10 classes

faster_rcnn.provenance: Native UP R50-FPN; one foreground class, original pretrained R50

detr.provenance: Same pinned official DETR R50 adapter in all three UP Runners; original UP has no DETR; official criterion unchanged, no deterministic CE rewrite

initialization: Generate once on original UP/NVIDIA; distribute identical CPU tensor files and verify SHA256 before loading strictly in every lane
audits: CPU metric recomputation from saved final predictions
nonblocking_diagnostics: Restored/inference metric variation on native kernels
paused_history: No old multi-seed controller resumed; previous reports are not counted as current results
